acceptance_criteria: Add a versioned deployment scaffold under deploy/flange_qc_v2/** for local replay, Jetson shadow, and RTX shadow targets.

The scaffold is disabled/manual by default and contains no production deploy commands, production release behavior, literal secrets, credential values, camera credentials, raw media paths, customer data, model weights, TensorRT engines, or live hardware requirements.
Add a deploy plan validator that fails closed if production deploy, live camera, raw media, secret-like values, or executable deploy commands are enabled.
Add unit tests proving the checked-in scaffold validates and unsafe variants are rejected.
Update Flange QC v2 deployment docs with the scaffold validation command, remaining open target decision, human release gate, and rollback expectations.
Add deploy plan validation to product CI without enabling any actual deploy provider.
Required local checks and product CI pass.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 deployment scaffold, Jetson/RTX target, manual disabled provider, no-secrets deployment validation
retrieved_lessons: Keep deployment scaffolds disabled by default.
Make blocked authorities explicit instead of implicit.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-016 PR to remove the deployment scaffold, validator/tests, product CI deploy-plan check, docs update, and gate evidence. This task does not alter production infrastructure, secrets, hardware state, raw media, customer data, migrations, or release/deploy configuration.
